title: The Choir Field
text: A plain of ash and rust, flatter than water. The mesas round it are worn; the plain isn't. Something levelled it long ago, and nothing has grown back. In the north a tower is still pulsing, and machines walk round it in a ring.

lines.text: "Machines that aren't ours. Be polite. I don't know how you're polite to a machine, but you'd know."
